title: x.sh App
description: Schema for x.sh app definition files (*.x.yml, x.yml)

name.description: The name of the app. Defaults to the filename (without the .x.yml suffix) when omitted

dir.description: Working directory to cd into before running handlers (relative to the app file or absolute)

options.description: Top-level options for the root command (alternative: `opts`)

opts.description: Top-level options for the root command (alternative: `options`)

arguments.description: Top-level positional arguments for the root command (alternative: `args`)

args.description: Top-level positional arguments for the root command (alternative: `arguments`)

$.description: Inline bash script run when the root command is invoked directly

$.import.description: External handler YAML files to import (legacy; prefer import.$)

import.description: Unified imports for handlers ($), env (.env files), and shell scripts (sh)

env.description: Global environment variables and .group named sets

^\\.[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$.description: A subcommand, defined with a `.` prefix

oneOf.description: Shorthand for a command whose only behavior is this inline script (equivalent to `$: <script>`)

arguments.description: Positional arguments accepted by this command (alternative: `args`)

args.description: Positional arguments accepted by this command (alternative: `arguments`)

dir.description: Working directory for this command's handler (and its subcommands, unless overridden). Relative to the app file or absolute

env.description: Environment variables for this command's handler (and its subcommands, unless overridden)

alias.description: Path to another x file; remaining arguments are dispatched to it as if `cd`'d into its directory

$.description: Inline bash script run when this command is invoked

^\\.[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$.description: A nested subcommand, defined with a `.` prefix

importBlock.description: Import handlers, .env files, and/or shell scripts

sh.description: Bash/zsh scripts sourced before each handler runs

oneOf.description: Inline expression string, or a multiline string split on newlines into a list of expressions
